preservation_map.claim: # CES Migration Permission Preservation
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## Overview
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: This topic defines the intended preservation of permission meaning when migrating from EMS2 production to CES UAT, covering mapped entitlement definitions and permission content for all scoped accounts. It also sets frontend compatibility and independent per-tile migration intent for `mfe-base`, the shared Ratan container, and their upper applications.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Scope is controlled by a series of user clarifications dated 3–9 November 2026. The document is a `candidate` draft and records user-stated intent, not verified execution.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## EMS2-to-CES concept mapping
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim:
| EMS2 concept | CES concept | Comparison boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Role | Entitlement | Compare mapped definition and assigned accounts |
| Entity | Application | Preserve application scope when comparing names |
| Subject | Feature | Compare through explicit feature mapping |
| Action | Action | Compare permitted operation within mapped feature |
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Names shared across different applications do not establish equivalent permissions, and numeric source identifiers may differ without changing mapped meaning. See [[concepts/ems2-to-ces-permission-mapping]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## Preservation requirements
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Entitlement and account parity
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The intended migration has no missing mapped entitlements or permission gaps, but that is an expectation, not retained proof. Entitlement definitions must be compared before catalog totals are treated as completeness evidence. Different entitlements can yield the same combined effective permissions without proving equal definitions or assignments. See [[summaries/KT-sdk-and-entitlements]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Account comparisons must include every account in the selected entity scope, expand multi-ID cells, and count each distinct account once. Application and entitlement scope must be retained, and data restrictions must be compared through authoritative definitions and resolved values—not profile names alone.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Coverage and FMO exception
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Fully matched migrated content moves into coverage totals and out of the active difference list; missing, additional, unresolved, and unavailable comparisons stay visible. An unavailable comparison proves neither equality nor missing permissions.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: FMO Portal Admin is excluded from the production comparison and tracked as a separate, lower-priority non-production item. Its content must not enter production coverage denominators.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## Frontend compatibility and per-tile migration
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: The primary objective is compatibility with existing upper-application APIs, adapting provider-specific identities and permission data internally. Non-unique roles are the known compatibility gap; this does not prove every other API is compatible.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Independent tile provider selection
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Each tile selects its entitlement provider independently. An EMS2 tile keeps existing admission logic; a CES tile uses CES admission logic, configured application identity, and CES permission structure. Moving one tile to CES must not force changes on unrelated tiles. In the migration contract, `EMS2 (CES)` denotes the CES path with wire value `EMS3`. See [[concepts/per-tile-provider-selection]] and [[concepts/portal-entry-and-tile-authorization]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Provider-union hasPermission
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Existing `hasPermission(code)` calls may accept a mapped grant from either EMS2 or CES. The check must log which provider supplied an accepted grant and must not require a new caller scope argument. This shared functional check is separate from tile admission. See [[concepts/permission-check-provider-union]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ### Role multiplicity and CES role-owned writes
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Multiple assigned CES roles must not be collapsed into one proven role, and callers expecting a scalar role require a sourced business mapping. CES saved-view and filter writes that require one owner role stay disabled until an ownership rule is agreed; no primary role may be selected and no comma-joined role names may be submitted as a scalar owner. Existing EMS2 role-owned writes keep their behavior. See [[concepts/ces-role-multiplicity]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## CES entity fields
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: Two new fields are required on EMS3 entities: `roleList` and `applicationId`. The table also records clarified values for the existing `name` and `applicationName` fields; those two existing fields are retained rather than introduced as additional new fields.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim:
| Field | Required value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roleList` | CES `entitlements.entitlement_name` values | Application-scoped assignment names |
| `applicationId` | CES application `itam_id` (e.g. `"51358"`) | CES application identity |
| `name` | `RATAN_ENTITLEMENT_RULE` | CES application/entity name for EMS2 `X_RATANONE` |
| `applicationName` | `RATAN` | Legacy team/display label |
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: CES `user_data.app_name` supplies the CES authorization name, not the legacy team label. These additions must not remove existing fields or change EMS2 decisions, and they do not resolve scalar role semantics. See [[entities/ratan]].
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim: ## Acceptance criteria
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.

preservation_map.claim:
- **FE-ROLE-WRITE-AC-001** — Zero CES role-owned write requests or fabricated scalar owners before an ownership rule exists; zero rule-induced EMS2 decision changes.
- **FE-COMPAT-AC-001** — Zero contradictory decisions for mapped feature/action permissions through existing caller APIs.
- **FE-COMPAT-AC-002** — Each tile admits through its selected provider with zero unrelated-application admissions.
- **FE-COMPAT-AC-003** — One tile may switch provider with zero forced changes on other tiles and zero required call-signature changes.
- **FE-COMPAT-AC-004** — `hasPermission(code)` returns the union of EMS2 and CES grants across four cases, with no extra arguments and provider-source logs for accepted decisions.
- **BFF-ENTITY-AC-001** — `roleList` contains the application's entitlement names with zero names imported from another application.
- **BFF-ENTITY-AC-002** — `applicationId`, `name`, and `applicationName` match declared values with zero legacy substitutions.
- **BFF-ENTITY-AC-003** — Additive metadata changes zero EMS2 decisions and removes zero existing fields.
preservation_map.note: Full paragraph preserved or source-version label updated.
